Extracts the basin draining to an outlet point, from a map of drainage directions.

**Toolbox folder:** Dem Manipulation<br>
**Status:** Experimental<br>
**Keywords:** Dem manipulation, Basin, Watershed, Outlet<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.ExtractBasin`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pNorth` | double |  | `-1.0` | The northing of the basin outlet, in the projection of the map. |
| `pEast` | double |  | `-1.0` | The easting of the basin outlet, in the projection of the map. |
| `inFlow` | raster file |  |  | The map of the drainage directions. |
| `inNetwork` | vector file |  |  | A user supplied network map. If available, the outlet point is snapped to it before extracting the basin. |
| `pSnapbuffer` | double |  | `200.0` | The maximum distance for the snapping of the outlet to the network, in map units. |
| `doSmoothing` | boolean |  | `false` | Flag to enable vector basin smoothing. |
| `doHighSpeed` | boolean |  | `false` | Enable high speed extraction. This requires -xss to be set high (ex -Xss1024g) on the JVM for huge basins. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outArea` | double |  | The area of the extracted basin, in squared map units. |
| `outBasin` | output file |  | The extracted basin mask. |
| `outOutlet` | output file |  | The optional outlet point vector map. |
| `outVectorBasin` | output file |  | The optional extracted basin vector map. |
